continuity: Ma Junggeol and the Seven Masters of Baekma Bang have recounted their history and are traveling with Taekyung’s group; Taekyung asks them to bring their mysterious benefactor, the Lord, to the group’s destination.
Taekyung and Jeok Cheongang judge that Ma Junggeol and his brothers are telling the truth and do not appear to be Dark Heaven spies; the Lord’s identity and motives remain unknown.
plot: After Ma Junggeol recounts more than a decade of events, Jin Taekyung and Jeok Cheongang conclude that Ma and his six sworn brothers are not lying and likely are not Dark Heaven spies. Their account makes the mysterious master they call the Lord seem deeply unpredictable: he appeared in Ningxia, subdued the area, and has lived there for nearly ten years, but they know little about his identity. Taekyung asks how long it would take to bring the Lord to their destination.
translation_decisions: Render 대인 as “the Lord” for Ma Junggeol and his brothers’ mysterious benefactor; distinguish this from 천주, “Lord of Heaven.”

active_continuity: Ma Junggeol and the Seven Masters of Baekma Bang are traveling with Taekyung’s group after recounting their history.

The Seven Masters revere a mysterious master they call the Lord, who appeared in Ningxia, subdued the area, and has lived there for nearly ten years; they know little about his identity and describe him as highly unpredictable.
Taekyung and Jeok Cheongang believe Ma Junggeol and his brothers are telling the truth and do not appear to be Dark Heaven spies.
Taekyung has asked Ma Junggeol’s group how long it would take to bring the Lord to their destination.
open_questions: Who is the Lord, and what are his motives and connection, if any, to Dark Heaven?
Will Ma Junggeol’s group bring the Lord to Taekyung’s destination?
What is Dark Heaven’s full strength and objective in the western desert, and have its forces begun advancing?
